task: ADR-020 (Explicit Policy Prior Warm-Starting), amended 2026-10-29 to the confirmed FDD-020 J1 to J6

criteria.description: architectural soundness: Re-approval after §4.1 to §4.4 were aligned with the code: a donor is checked structurally and its ADR-003 gate recorded without blocking, the target must be cold so learned logits are never overwritten, the provenance gains the action map, donor kind and donor gate result, the copy is a new active version of the target, a family meta-prior is applied by the same command with the target's declared role_map and a default damping of 1.0, and the action map rule is stated so it can actually be a bijection.
